[project]
name = "comfyui-meta-sam-audio"
version = "0.4.0"
description = "Native ComfyUI nodes for local Meta SAM-Audio sound separation"
readme = "README.md"
requires-python = ">=3.11"
license = { file = "LICENSE" }
authors = [{ name = "ComfyUI SAM-Audio contributors" }]
dependencies = [
    "einops",
    "ftfy",
    "huggingface-hub",
    "regex",
    "safetensors",
    "timm",
    "torchdiffeq",
    "tqdm",
    "transformers>=4.54.0",
]

[project.urls]
Repository = "https://github.com/ethanfel/ComfyUI-SAM-Audio"
Issues = "https://github.com/ethanfel/ComfyUI-SAM-Audio/issues"
Upstream = "https://github.com/facebookresearch/sam-audio"

[project.optional-dependencies]
test = ["pytest>=8", "ruff"]

[tool.comfy]
PublisherId = "ethanfel"
DisplayName = "Meta SAM-Audio"
Icon = ""

[tool.pytest.ini_options]
testpaths = ["tests"]

[tool.ruff]
target-version = "py311"
lint.select = ["B", "E", "F", "I", "W"]
lint.ignore = ["E501"]

# Runtime-only dependencies. Meta's source packages are installed with --no-deps
# by install.py so their training stacks cannot alter ComfyUI's core packages.
einops
ftfy
huggingface-hub
regex
safetensors
timm
torchdiffeq
tqdm
transformers>=4.54.0
